title: Placing in the old creek bed is refused
about: Map stages (M2, WORLD-PLAN 4.2.2). Dry farm, on the bed's west bank facing it, sprinklers in the bag and selected. Action (or a tap on the bed) answers "The old creek bed. Best left clear." and nothing is placed; the hoe gets the same answer. Placing on the bank (x 25) still works.
